body.p: (task 0.7). Namespace URIs, prefixes and expanded names are interned into dense 32-bit identifiers in a per-processor sxml_name_pool; comparing names is comparing integers, and nodes and QName items hold no text. URI and prefix identifier 0 mean "none"; name identifier 0 means "no name". A fixed set of well-known namespaces (xml, xs, fn, err, ...) have constant identifiers in every pool. Names are never removed; maximum_byte_count bounds growth on untrusted input, and sxml_name_pool_find_name looks up without interning. Prefixes are kept beside names, never part of their identity (XDM 4.0, section 5.6).
